verified_facts.text: The hotel sits in the center of the historic Dupont Circle neighborhood, a short stroll from the city's monuments.
verified_facts.excerpt: With a thrilling landmark position in the center of the historic Dupont Circle neighborhood and a short stroll from the city's most iconic monuments

verified_facts.text: The hotel was refurbished in collaboration with designers Martin Brudnizki and Clodagh.
verified_facts.excerpt: Following a transformative refurbishment in collaboration with world-renowned designers Martin Brudnizki and Clodagh

verified_facts.text: The design blends contemporary comfort with a mid-century aesthetic that pays homage to the building's beginnings.
verified_facts.excerpt: seamlessly weaves contemporary comfort and style with a mid-century aesthetic that pays homage to the building’s beginnings

verified_facts.text: The Penthouse Level is an exclusive floor of individually designed suites.
verified_facts.excerpt: On the Penthouse Level, an exclusive floor composed of 12 individually-designed suites, guests are invited to indulge in the ultimate city stay.

verified_facts.text: Suites with private furnished terraces have panoramic city views from the Washington Monument to the National Cathedral.
verified_facts.excerpt: Suites with private, furnished terraces offer incomparable panoramic city views, stretching from the Washington Monument to the National Cathedral.

verified_facts.text: The Grand Penthouse was designed by Irish-born designer Clodagh and has five private heated terraces.
verified_facts.excerpt: the Grand Penthouse, designed by Irish-born and internationally acclaimed Clodagh, is one of Washington D.C.’s largest suites and features five private heated terraces

verified_facts.text: Guest rooms and suites blend art-forward design with modern comforts.
verified_facts.excerpt: suites across nine floors that seamlessly blend art-forward design with modern comforts

verified_facts.text: Doyle Bar has views of Dupont Circle and nods to the cocktail culture of the 1950s and 60s.
verified_facts.excerpt: Featuring sweeping views of Dupont Circle alongside warm wood paneling, soft jewel-toned banquettes and vibrant artwork, the bar effortlessly nods to the cocktail culture of the 1950s and 60s.

verified_facts.text: Doyle Bar has a collection of Irish whiskeys.
verified_facts.excerpt: This beautiful Washington, D.C. bar also boasts an impressive collection of Irish whiskeys

verified_facts.text: The Pembroke restaurant was designed by Martin Brudnizki.
verified_facts.excerpt:
Designed by Martin Brudnizki,
The Pembroke restaurant is an established dining destination

verified_facts.text: The hotel is owned and managed by The Doyle Collection, an Irish family-owned hotel group.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Dupont Circle is owned and managed by The Doyle Collection, an Irish family-owned luxury hotel group

verified_facts.text: The hotel is less than a two-minute walk from the Dupont Circle Metro Station.
verified_facts.excerpt: The property is less than a two-minute stroll from the Dupont Circle Metro Station

verified_facts.text: The ninth-floor penthouse level is reached by a private elevator.
verified_facts.excerpt: On the ninth-floor penthouse level, accessible via a private elevator, there are 12 residential-style suites

verified_facts.text: Bathrooms have marble tiles, heated floors and Malin + Goetz bath products.
verified_facts.excerpt: the spa-like bathroom with marble tiles, heated floors, plush bathrobes, and Malin + Goetz bath products

verified_facts.text: Nightly turndown service and room service are available.
verified_facts.excerpt: More available in-room amenities include complimentary Wi-Fi, nightly turndown service, dry cleaning and laundry services, and room service.

verified_facts.text: The lobby has space to work or read by the fireplace.
verified_facts.excerpt: There’s ample space for setting up shop to work, read a book by the fireplace, or meet a friend for coffee.

verified_facts.text: Service centers on welcoming Irish hospitality.
verified_facts.excerpt: welcoming Irish hospitality at the forefront of The Dupont Circle’s service

verified_facts.excerpt: guests can pop by Doyle & Co Coffee Bar, located just off the lobby. Snag homemade pastries and lattes before heading out for the day.
